journey.name: Copy to edit — following is the only offer, and a copy is reached from Edit
journey.description:
Deck detail for a deck you do not own (#254). Following used to sit beside a Clone pill of equal weight, which asked a reader who had just found a deck to choose between two words whose difference they had no reason to know yet. Follow is now the only offer; a copy is surfaced when you try to *edit* a deck you follow, where the difference is the question being asked.
Needs a signed-in account and a deck published by somebody else — any tile in Discover whose author is not you. A small deck keeps the copy short.

actions.action: Launch Loopky, sign in, and open the Discover tab
Open a deck published by another author (a "discover_deck_tile" whose author is not you)

Verify the deck offers "Follow deck" (resource-id: deck_follow) and NOTHING else that writes: there must be no Clone button (resource-id "deck_clone" must not exist) and no Edit control (resource-id "deck_edit") on a deck you have not followed
Verify the Follow pill spans the full content width rather than sharing the row

Verify the stats bar carries no Due, New or Mastered column — none of the three means anything before you keep the deck — and that its room went to the deck's own counts instead: Total beside Followers, and Copies when anyone has copied it (resource-ids: deck_stat_followers, deck_stat_copies). A count the indexer has not answered for is absent, never a "0", so a deck nobody follows yet legitimately shows Total alone.
Verify the follower count is NOT also printed as a caption above the author (resource-id "deck_follower_count" must not exist here) — the stats bar is carrying it, and twice is once too many
Tap "deck_follow" and verify it flips to "Following" immediately; dismiss the "Share this on Pubky?" prompt if it appears

Verify the stats bar has now swapped back: Total, Due, New and Mastered, with the follower and copy counts returning to their caption above the author (resource-id: deck_follower_count). Following is what makes your own progress a real number.
Verify an Edit control (resource-id: deck_edit) has now appeared in the header, and that there is still no Delete control (a followed deck is not yours to delete)

Tap "deck_edit" and verify it does NOT open the deck editor. A copy prompt appears instead, titled "Make your own copy?", naming the card count and saying the copy will not get the author's updates and that progress starts over.
Verify the confirm button (resource-id: deck_clone_confirm) is DISABLED while the name field (resource-id: deck_clone_title) is empty — naming the copy is mandatory

Type the source deck's own title into "deck_clone_title", in any case or with extra spaces, and verify an error appears (resource-id: deck_clone_name_error) reading "Pick a different name from the original." and that "deck_clone_confirm" stays disabled
Replace it with a different name and verify the error clears and "deck_clone_confirm" becomes enabled
Tap "deck_clone_confirm" and verify a "Copying deck…" progress state is shown while the copy is written

Verify that when it finishes the progress state CLEARS and the screen moves to the copy — do this with "Share on Pubky" switched OFF in Settings as well as on, since the spinner used to be cleared only on the share-prompt path and a copy made with the setting off left "Copying deck…" up forever (#254)

Verify the screen now shows the copy: the name you typed, an "IN YOUR LIBRARY" badge, "Cloned from <original author>", Edit and Delete controls, the same card count, and Study offering the copy's own new cards
Go back and verify the copy appears in the Decks tab under its new name, alongside the deck it was copied from
Open the original deck again and verify it is no longer followed — copying it unfollows it, since you own a copy now
